is_anopheles.evidence: The study surveys Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. arabiensis, An. melas, and An. gambiae s.s.) in Dakar, Senegal (page 1, Abstract; page 7, 'Molecular identification of An. gambiae s.l').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyping of Kdr-w (Vgsc L995F) and Ace-1 (G280S) is reported on page 7 ('Kdr-w and Ace1 mutation frequencies in An. gambiae s.l' and Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 7 gives genotypic counts and frequencies (RR, RS, SS) for Kdr in An. arabiensis from Bel-air (RR=11, RS=4, SS=94, total=109) and Ouakam (RR=5, RS=9, SS=90, total=104). The text also notes Ace-1 mutations were not detected in any tested mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: Adult mosquitoes were collected by human landing catches (indoors and outdoors) in Dakar, Senegal (Bel-air and Ouakam districts) between May 2005 and October 2006 (page 2, 'Field mosquito processing').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper describing original field entomological surveys and molecular testing.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected at specific districts in Dakar, Senegal: Bel-air and Ouakam (page 2, 'Location').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field sampling for the genotyped mosquitoes was conducted between May 2005 and May 2006 (Table 3, page 7).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original entomological surveillance conducted by the authors in French military camps in Dakar.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and data are contained within the main text and Table 3.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated malaria transmission and vector dynamics in two districts of Dakar, Senegal (Bel-air and Ouakam) from 2005 to 2006. Genotyping of field-collected An. arabiensis identified Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) at allele frequencies of 12% in Bel-air and 9% in Ouakam, with full genotype counts reported. Ace-1 G280S was also assayed and found to be absent.
